Trent Krabbles (Japanese: , Toronto Kuraibu) are quest-exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. They are members of the Krabble family, and can be found at level 2 at Argentum's Goldmouth Return Port during Cargo Escort. Five of them must be defeated over the course of the quest, and a level 1 Trent Krabble appears during the third objective of the quest. This enemy drops no items.
Triple Flash (Japanese: , Toripurufurasshu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Chroma Katana.

Treesap Conditioners are Cosmetic Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Cosmetipolitan in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. Two are obtained as a reward for completing the quest Knocked About Nopon.
Tretl Windmill Plaza (Japanese: , Toreita Fūsha Hiroba) is a Location in . It is located in Torigoth in the Gormott Province, directly adjacent to the Torigoth Market.

Twin Trunks Hill (Japanese: , Sōju no Oka) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level - Right of the Gormott Province, overlooking Garanti Plain, Lyta Oasis, the Sauros's Bed, and the pond into which Varnax's Plunge drains. The Boulderbore Gate is here, and Tirkin Turf and Dawnview Grotto can be reached by climbing from the hill.

The Turbine Tower (Japanese: , Chinetsu Tābin-tō) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain. It is located between Midorl Bridge and Mine No. 2 Entrance, or due SE of Mine Elevator. There is a Treasure Trove here containing a Magnet Chip. In the middle of this location, there is a metallic circle spewing out steam. This damages any character in it for about 9% of their health twice for every second the character is in it.
The Twin Pillars (Japanese: , Futago Shichū) are a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, between Amphoret Pillar and Hope's Horizon.
Twinklejuices are Drink Pouch items in . They can be purchased from 12 Brothersisterpon in the Argentum Trade Guild. They are one of the favorite pouch items of Corvin.
Tube Xylophones are Instrument Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Adelno Music in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Tros is an NPC in . Tros is a Gormotti who can be found in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. Tros runs a shop called Soniarus Music specialized in Instruments.

Tricolor Bowls are Staple Food Pouch items in . They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Nim. They can be cooked by Pyra at the kitchens in Tora's House and Corinne's House after purchasing An Ardainian Recipe from the Informant in Alba Cavanich, Mor Ardain.

Tyrannotitan Kurodil (Japanese: , Bōgyaku Kyoshinjū Kurodairu) is one of the Superbosses in . It is a Unique Monster and a Ballistaur Titan; it can be found at level 130 in the Profaned Place of Temperantia. It is sealed in an ice crystal that requires level 12 "Fire Mastery" and level 8 "Focus" Field Skills to melt, and is in turn blocked by malign miasma that requires level 5 "Dark Mastery" and "Ancient Wisdom" Field Skills to unblock.

Troog Lysaats (Japanese: , Toruka Shīsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lysaat family and can be found at level 3-7 at the Saets Chief's Residence or the Grodd Residential Zone in the Gormott Province after Salvaging.

Ultimate Weaponry are Key Items in . They add 5000 WP to a weapon class of a Driver. They can be received as rewards for completing a Rare or Legendary Blade's Affinity Chart, in the Land of Challenge from White Chests obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, and from the Mor Ardain Traveling Bard by trading 400,000 Bonus EXP.
Trock Tirkin (Japanese: , Dorakeru Tākin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 82-87 at the Old Gelgemos Gate on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.
True Dragon Incenses are Key Items in . Two are guarded by Vampire Bride Marion in the Dragon's Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya. They are required for A Secret Cure.
Tricky Discs are Mechanical collectibles in . They can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Tricolor Rocks are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya, in particular from the Collection Point south of the Stone Gate Ruins, on the west side of the road. Dahlia can turn a Tricolor Rock into a Tricolor Ice Floe with her level 1 "Icecraft" field skill in the Goldmouth Warehouse.
Trippy Catfishes are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in Temperantia.
Twinkle Leaves are Tree collectibles in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Uraya, in particular from the Collection Points near Yurna the Elderwood and near the Crown of Sanctuary in the Stomach.

Ultimate Lightning Fury Slash Max (Japanese: ), abbreviated ULFS Max, is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Big Bang Edge. It deals high AOE damage and can inflict Blowdown on the target.

Triumphal Axe (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Greataxe. When used, Zeke holds his greataxe on his shoulders and does two quick spinning slashes then finishes with a slash to the right.

Turquoise Chips are Core Chips in and . In they can be purchased at the Proplater Blacksmiths shop in the Kingdom of Uraya, found in a Treasure Trove on the Titan Battleship, and dropped by four enemies. In , they are primarily quest rewards. Turquoise Chips share their appearance with Spinel Chips, Fluorite Chips and Amethyst Chips. __TOC__

Trilut Grebels (Japanese: , Toriruto Tasuman) are enemies in . They are members of the Grebel family, and can be found at level 47-49 at Idora Cave, Runo Cave-in, Balquors Ruins or Cape O-uru at the Cliffs of Morytha. Five of them must be defeated in order to unlock Electra's level 4 "Electric Mastery" and Akhos's level 4 Sacred Wyrm.

Trust is a mechanic in and . It is used mainly for unlocking the five tiers of many Blade's Affinity Charts and accessing their Key Affinity Rewards. Trust levels can be raised by reaching max Affinity in battle, giving Blades Pouch items, completing Quests and Merc Missions, or by viewing Heart-to-Hearts (where different choices raise trust by varying amounts). Trust is measured in levels, starting from E, reaching S when a Blade's Affinity Chart is completed, and maxing out at S+. Higher trust leads to a higher Auto-Attack stat (which increases all damage), higher chance for Blade Arts occurring, and reduced Blade Switch times, amongst other bonuses.
